title: Device configuration assigned to All Users on a large Windows estate

minWindowsDevices.text: Windows devices above which All Users configuration without a filter is worth reporting

report.title: {Items.Count} configuration {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile targets', 'profiles target')} All Users without a filter

messages.businessImpact: User-scoped configuration without a filter lands on every user context in a large estate, which is usually broader than the setting was designed for and hard to roll back.
remediation: Prefer device groups for device settings, or add an include filter that limits the All Users assignment.
messages.cannotSee: Endpoint security policies and update rings are not in this scope. Mixed user and device targeting is HYG-008. Whether the profile's settings are themselves user-scoped is CFG-009.
